description: This Java class 'EntityAutoEngine' implements a service engine for entity operations such as create, update, delete, and expire within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles dynamic entity management based on service parameters, including primary key handling, validation, and related business logic.

classes.name: EntityAutoEngine
classes.description: A final class extending 'GenericAsyncEngine' that provides entity operation methods such as create, update, delete, and expire, based on service parameters within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Overrides 'runSyncIgnore' to call 'runSync' and ignore exceptions.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Main method executing create, update, delete, or expire operations based on service parameters and handling validation, primary key logic, and error handling.

methods.name: invokeCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of new entity instances, including primary key generation, validation, and setting audit fields.

methods.name: invokeUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating existing entity instances, including validation, status change validation, and audit fields.

methods.name: invokeDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of entity instances based on primary key lookup.

methods.name: invokeExpire
methods.description: Handles expiring (setting thruDate) of entity instances, including date validation and setting.

methods.name: isValidText
methods.description: Validates security-sensitive text parameters to prevent security issues.
